evidence: Platinum ALD was accomplished using alternating exposures to MeCpPtMe3 and 400 sccm of ultrahigh purity (99.995% pure) oxygen at 300 °C using 360 sccm of ultrahigh purity (99.995% pure) nitrogen carrier gas at a steady state pressure of ∼1 Torr. Each Pt ALD cycle consisted of a 10 s exposure to MeCpPtMe3, a 5 s N2 purge period, a 5 s exposure to O2, and a final 5 s N2 purge period.
